annotations.title: Compare quotes and costs across exchanges

description: Use to choose where to trade one perpetual futures coin: bid, ask, spread, trading fee (your account's rate or the published one) and 7-day execution, per exchange. With side (and size_base or notional_usd): ranked by price plus taker fee plus a cost for poor execution; hold_hours adds funding, exit fee. cheapest_venue: cheapest overall; best_venue: cheapest you can trade on now (connected, allowed, enough margin); if they differ, say both. Not for one venue's depth (use get_order_book). No rebates. Next: preview_order with best_venue, or venue "best".

hold_hours.description: Optional, with side: how long you expect to hold, in hours; adds funding at today's rate and the exit fee, and ranks by that total cost

side.description: Optional: rank by the all-in price for this side (the price you would take plus the venue's taker fee)

size_base.description: Optional, with side: size in the base coin, to see each venue's cost in USD and whether your free margin there covers it

name: compare_venue_prices

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

executions.description: Orders TradeHub executed or failed to execute there

fill_rate.description: Share that filled, 0-1; null without executions

median_fee_bps.description: Fee the exchange actually charged, basis points of notional (from its fill records); null until known

median_slippage_bps.description: Fill against the preview's mark, basis points, positive = worse

age_seconds.description: How old this quote is, in seconds

all_in_price.description: With side: price plus the taker fee, USD per coin

allowed.description: With an account: this agent's permissions allow it

connected.description: With an account: you have this venue connected

cost_bps.description: With side: all_in_price against the mid in basis points (half the spread plus the fee); lower is cheaper

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

effective_cost_bps.description: With hold_hours: total_cost_bps plus quality_bps; the ranking key

effective_price.description: With side: all_in_price adjusted by quality_bps, USD per coin; the ranking key without hold_hours

enough_margin.description: With a size: free margin covers it

est_cost_usd.description: With a size: what trading at all_in_price costs against the mid, USD

est_funding_bps.description: With hold_hours: funding you would pay over that time at today's rate, basis points of notional; negative = you receive it

est_funding_usd.description: With hold_hours and a size: that funding in USD

est_total_cost_usd.description: With hold_hours and a size: the whole round trip's cost in USD

execution_7d.description: TradeHub's measured execution on this venue, all users, last 7 days

fee_source.description: account: your own rate as the exchange reports it; published: the base rate (no account, or the exchange does not say); none: the sandbox

fee_usd.description: With a size: the taker fee in USD

free_margin_usd.description: With an account and side: free margin on this venue, USD

funding_interval_hours.description: With hold_hours: hours between funding payments

funding_rate.description: With hold_hours: funding rate per interval now, positive = longs pay

maker_fee_bps.description: Fee for an order that rests on the book, basis points of notional

margin_needed_usd.description: With a size: margin needed at the given leverage, USD

price.description: With side: the price you would take (ask to buy, bid to sell), USD per coin

quality_bps.description: With side: measured execution quality as a cost, basis points (the rule is in ranking_basis); 0 without executions

size_base.description: With a size: the size used, base coin

stale.description: True if older than 10 seconds; ranked last

taker_fee_bps.description: Fee for an order that takes liquidity (market orders), basis points of notional

total_cost_bps.description: With hold_hours: entry cost against the mid, entry and exit taker fees and that funding

as_of.description: When this comparison was made, ISO 8601 UTC

best_ask_venue.description: Fresh venue with the lowest ask (best to buy)

best_bid_venue.description: Fresh venue with the highest bid (best to sell)

best_venue.description: With side: the cheapest all-in venue you can use (connected, allowed, enough margin); without an account, the cheapest overall; null if none

cheapest_venue.description: With side: the cheapest all-in real venue, whether or not you can use it (fresh quotes only); null if none

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

neutrality.description: Commercial relationships that could affect the order (none)

venues.description: One entry per venue that lists the coin, in ranking order

title: Compare quotes and costs across exchanges
